source_text: Aedificat altare, ligat Isaac. Fides usque ad mortem; unigenitus non parcetur.
pass_a_gloss: Builds altar, binds Isaac. Faith as-far-as to death; only-begotten not will-be-spared.
pass_b_english: He builds the altar and [[binds Isaac >> Bible:Genesis 22:9]]. Faith unto death; [[he did not spare his only son >> Bible:Romans 8:32]] (in figure).
